role: Methods and axis-independence audit; inherited model family, no independent replication
verdict: Usable as a purposive, evidence-linked ranking on separate axes, with explicit scope, uncertainty and reviewer disagreement. It is not an exhaustive bibliography or a statistical ranking of materials science.

axisAudit.finding: Conceptually separable but likely correlated in this selected corpus. Cite vocabulary changes, compositional conditions, and executed coordination separately; do not reuse one architecture label as evidence for all three.
Rate material response or modal targets separately from iterative agent behavior. Agent iteration is not material dynamics.
An operational cross-domain mapping can be strong transfer while remaining weak evidence for a mechanism. Distant language alone is insufficient.
Closure and discrimination differ: fabrication can close a loop while controls remain narrow. Formal consistency is conditional and cannot establish material fidelity.
Apply mathematical guarantees beyond category theory. Composed equivariant layers and energy-derived forces can warrant the highest anchor when proved and implemented.

calibration.judgment: Comparator profiles are coherent with the frozen anchors, conditional on the parent primary-source reviews. They are three strong selected exemplars, not an estimate of the distribution of standard materials papers.
calibration.importantInterpretation: A-Lab organization1 refers to reorganization of discovery work, not low autonomy; its physical closed loop still receives validation4. NequIP formal4 prevents category-theory favoritism.
distinctivePoles: Representation revision: COPRESHEAF exceeds the supplied comparators on this axis.
Distant structural transfer: STIMULUS and SCIENCECLAW lead the assessed corpus.
Detailed modal inverse design: VIBEGEN and SCIENCECLAW lead dynamics.
Artifact- or need-driven organization: SCIENCECLAW and COPRESHEAF lead this particular coordination axis.
Formal structure, mechanistic explanation and physical closure have strong comparator counterparts; these are not unique Buehler advantages.

paperRecommendations.reason: Dynamic speaker selection among predefined roles is adaptive scheduling, not demonstrated artifact- or need-driven distributed coordination.
Reader credits a compact interpretable interaction distinguishing additive alternatives; auditor requires stronger out-of-sample discrimination before that anchor.
Explicit preservation conditions and audits, not a completely certified deployed categorical substrate.
Audited revision of the committed symbolic schema; novelty remains relative to that declared schema.
An explicit experiment claim can indicate closure type, while its methods and strength remain unaudited. Keep all unread dimensions null and visibly mark coverage.
Say no central formal composition constraint assessed, rather than no categorical constraint. The rubric also recognizes symmetry and conservation guarantees.

findings.claim: The implemented provenance layer is weaker than complete software-enforced functorial certification.
Protein fits use accumulated evidence; the mixed slice enters refitting and selection, so it is not an untouched test.
The product interaction is new relative to the admitted schema, while its GNM quantities already exist.
HEA median-threshold/slope gate yields a public-data hypothesis, not new fatigue testing.

auditorCautions: Operator-library and search-budget matched comparisons, plus held-out protein families, would strengthen discovery claims.
Residues within chains are dependent; complexity penalties do not replace external prediction tests.
Paris growth depends on C, loading range and conditions as well as slope; phase differences can confound summary comparisons.

reportingRequirements: Keep scores ordinal, ties intact and no arithmetic total.
Use null for insufficient reviewed evidence; no zero imputation.
Display confidence and abstract-only coverage alongside rank.
Report pairwise-complete rank correlations with sample sizes as redundancy diagnostics; no statistical independence claim.
Label conceptual surprise, tested empirical surprise and formal surprise distinctly.
Do not call generated reviews or this audit independent scientific replication.
Coverage is 18 selected papers, not every Buehler publication.
limitations: Selection favors conceptual breadth and agentic work.
Most papers have one bounded reader; the audit fully reread only two primary texts.
No literature-wide novelty priority search was performed.
Ordinal judgments can move with additional methods, supplements or revised versions.

SCIAGENTS.organization.rationale: Adaptive speaker selection operates within prescribed roles; distributed need-driven routing is not established.

SILK.formal.rationale: No central formal composition or transport constraint drives this mechanics contribution.

COPRESHEAF.explanation.rationale: A compact physically interpretable interaction improves over additive alternatives on accumulated evidence; causal uniqueness is unestablished.

alternativeScores.rationale: Symbolic model selection supports an interpretable relationship; independent causal mechanics and untouched-protein tests remain open.
